title: Component
description: A single node in the SDUI component tree

type.description: Component type identifier. Must match a key in the client ComponentRegistry

props.description: Component-specific properties. Shape varies by type — validated at runtime by the renderer

actions.description: Actions available on this component (e.g. onTap, onSubmit)

fallback.description: Alternative component to render when this type is unknown to the client (ADR-002 hybrid fallback)

critical.description: When true, the server must check X-App-Version before sending this component (ADR-002)
